steps.name: Project plus is visible
steps.goal: Reach the isolated demo home screen. Accept the AI data notice for this demo fixture if shown. Do not enter a message.
steps.done: The first project pill shows a complete centered plus icon beside the project names at the largest text setting.

steps.name: Plus pill remains visible when selected
steps.goal: Tap only Chats without a project, the first pill in the project rail. Do not tap the plus in the bottom composer.
steps.done: The plus pill is selected and still shows the complete centered plus. The starter rail and composer are visible below.

steps.name: Project selection restores task list
steps.goal: Tap api-gateway folder in the project rail.
steps.done: The project is selected and its task list is visible. The plus pill remains visible beside it.
